svg.text: Derived printed cover / actual mesh section
Section at Y = 0 mm through the pole axis. Source geometry + fused boss + open underside well.
Green: exact delivered mesh section / Gray: provisional screw envelope
The well opens through the sloping underside. The head is fully recessed; it is not trapped in a closed pocket.
Geometry inspection only. No structural, material, tolerance or print-readiness validation is implied.
